# Furbago

> Furbago is your travel marketplace to explore and book holiday packages, vacation or weekend staycations, and unique local experiences - all in one place.

## About This Site
Furbago is a curated experiential travel marketplace connecting travelers with authentic local tours, activities, and unique stays across India. We focus on creating memorable, host-led experiences-from cultural walks and adventure trails to offbeat homestays—designed for Gen-Z and Millennial explorers.

## Why Book With Us

- All listings are handpicked from reliable local providers.
- Communicate directly with providers and travel experts for quick answers and transparency.
- Enjoy competitive pricing with no hidden charges — what you see is what you pay.
- Simple, user-friendly booking process.
- 24/7 direct support for any questions or changes.
- Flexible cancellation policies to fit your needs.
- Itinerary customization available to suit your travel plans.

## How To Book

1. Browse holiday packages, staycations, and local experiences tailored to your interests.
2. Choose your preferred date and number of guests.
3. Complete the booking and payment process online.
4. You'll receive a notification once your booking is confirmed.
5. Want something custom? Send us a message or fill out the enquiry form before booking.

## Rewards

- Get coins when you sign up or refer friends.
- Earn more coins after completing a trip or activity.
- Apply your earned coins as discounts on future bookings.

## Mission

- Empower small and local vendors in the experiential travel space.
- Provide a tech-enabled platform to grow and manage their businesses efficiently.
- Offer training in daily operations to improve service quality and sustainability.
- Keep vendors informed about changing global travel trends to help them adapt.
- Share local and global analytics to guide smarter business decisions.
- Encourage travelers to explore destinations with fresh, immersive perspectives.
- Promote awareness of experiential and sustainable travel among both providers and travelers.
